runs.scenario: User asks for help implementing a new feature in a React + Node.js application.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt explicitly bans AI visual tells (pure black, neon glow, generic card layouts, Inter/Roboto fonts)
criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly bans pure black, neon/outer glows, 3-column generic card layouts, and the Inter font in the 'AI TELLS (Forbidden Patterns)' section.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt requires all 7 interaction states (default, hover, active, focus, loading, empty, error)
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt explicitly requires implementing full interaction cycles including loading, empty states, error states, tactile feedback (:active), focus-visible states, and mentions :hover states.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt specifies spring/ease curves, not linear. Avoids janky animations.
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt specifies using premium Spring Physics (stiffness: 100, damping: 20) with no linear easing, cubic-bezier transitions, and enforces hardware acceleration (animating only transform and opacity) to avoid jank.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt enforces clear typography hierarchy with specific font choices
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt enforces deterministic typography with specific classes for Display/Headlines and Body/Paragraphs, and mandates specific high-end fonts like Geist, Outfit, Cabinet Grotesk, or Satoshi.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt uses a deliberate color system, not arbitrary hex values
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt mandates a strict color calibration rule: max 1 accent color, absolute neutral bases (Zinc/Slate), and strict color consistency across the project.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt enforces consistent spacing scale (not random padding/margin values)
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt enforces the use of Tailwind CSS (which provides a consistent spacing scale) and explicitly requires mathematically perfect padding and margins, avoiding awkward gaps.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt requires WCAG contrast ratios and focus-visible indicators
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt has a mandatory Accessibility section that explicitly requires WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios and clear focus-visible indicators for all interactive elements.
